note: Approved by the New Hampshire Executive Council 2026-03-16. FHC is the designated statewide administrator for GO-NORTH and describes itself as 'the statewide leader and unified voice for New Hampshire's hospitals and health systems'. It has named NO subrecipient: every funding opportunity it publishes is open, upcoming, or closed without a roster, and the Critical Access Hospital and Acute Care Hospital RFA is 'Coming Soon'. FHC's own planning figure is '50-100 active subrecipient awards' -- A RANGE OF FUTURE AWARDS IS NOT A ROSTER (§0.3).
source_document_title: GO-NORTH FHC Rural Health Transformation Program
recipient_type_source: Not stated as a legal form. FHC self-describes as 'the statewide leader and unified voice for New Hampshire's hospitals and health systems', which is §10.2's hospital-body branch; it is NONPROFIT_CBO on AK's and IL's convention.
determination_basis: §10.2 PASS_THROUGH_UNRESOLVED, and the contrast with Illinois is the whole reason. ICAHN codes `Yes` because its eligibility was restricted to HOSPITALS ONLY and its award was executed -- both clauses of §10.2's PASS_THROUGH_DESIGNATED row. FHC's award is executed, but its eligible class is, in its own words, 'primary care, critical access hospitals, EMS, behavioral health, oral health, and community-based organizations' -- hospitals AMONG other eligible entities. §0.3: eligibility is not receipt, and an unresolved pass-through pool codes Unclear and is NEVER imputed. It enters NEITHER bucket of rhtp_hospital_dollar_partition().
amount_basis: EXACT, from the page's own CMS financial-assistance footer: 'financial assistance award totaling $66,547,394'. The programme-scoped Council sentence states the same award ROUNDED ($66.5 million), and the two agree. The footer is used here for what session 27's audit says it can carry -- AN AMOUNT -- and not as the provenance.

awardee: New Hampshire Community Development Finance Authority (CDFA)
note: Approved by the same Governor and Executive Council action of 2026-03-16. CDFA states 'up to $40 million a year' -- A CEILING, NOT AN AWARD FIGURE -- so `amount` is EMPTY and the ceiling is in `round_amount` (South Dakota's device). Its eligible facilities are 'rural health clinics, community mental health centers, federally qualified health centers and county-run assisted living facilities' -- HOSPITALS ARE NOT IN THAT CLASS, so this is NON_HOSPITAL on the recipient class the source itself states.
source_document_title: CDFA Statement about the Rural Community Health Infrastructure Programs
recipient_type_source: A state-chartered public instrumentality administering community development funds. Not stated as a legal form on the page; NONPROFIT_CBO on §8's standing fallback.
determination_basis: §10.2 NON_HOSPITAL, judged on the RECIPIENT CLASS the source itself states (§0.3a): CDFA's eligible facilities are rural health clinics, community mental health centres, FQHCs and county-run assisted living facilities. Hospitals are not among them. No hospital dollar either way.
amount_basis: NOT PUBLISHED. CDFA states 'up to $40 million a year', which is a ceiling on a programme and not an award to CDFA. `amount` is deliberately empty so no sum over the column can read as a per-recipient figure (§6.2).
